title: USB Desktop Breeze Machine
body:
Perfect for your desk at work. Plugs into USB. Your coworkers will be jealous of your personal breeze.

Features:
- USB powered
- 2 speeds
- 360° rotation
- Near-silent operation
- Cute AND functional
